dialogue.content: （おはようございます。11:30からのロープレ、どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Good morning. I'm looking forward to our role-playing session starting at 11:30.)

dialogue.content: （おはようございます）こちらこそ、よろしくお願い致します
dialogue.English: (Good morning.) Likewise, I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: （返信ありがとうございます。お時間になりましたら、私からトークお送りしますね。では、その時に！）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your reply. When the time comes, I'll send a message to start the chat. See you then!)

dialogue.content: （はい！）
dialogue.English: (Yes!)

dialogue.content: （では、始めますね。）こんにちわ。LINE相談室です。今日はどうされましたか？
dialogue.English: (Alright, let's begin.) Hello. This is the LINE Counseling Room. What brings you in today?

dialogue.content: こんにちは今日は、父親のことで悩んでまして。。
dialogue.English: Hello. Today, I'm worried about my father...

dialogue.content: 足の調子が悪いのですが
dialogue.English: He's having trouble with his leg,

dialogue.content: 全然リハビリしようとしないんです。
dialogue.English: But he won't do any rehabilitation at all.

dialogue.content: お父さま、自宅療養中？
dialogue.English: Is your father recuperating at home?

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 頑張れば、外にも出れるのですが、もう半年くらい家にいたままで
dialogue.English: He could go outside if he tried, but he's been staying at home for about six months now.

dialogue.content: では、毎日、あなたとも顔を合わせるわけですね。半年！もっと詳しくお聞きしたいのですが、あなたのお年、性別、この相談でお呼びするお名前、教えてもらっていいですか？
dialogue.English: So, you see him every day, then. Half a year! I'd like to ask for a bit more detail. Could you please tell me your age, gender, and the name you'd like to be called during this session?

dialogue.content: 私は、愛と申します。愛と、呼んでください。年齢は、44歳女性父とは、一緒には住んでおりません。
dialogue.English: My name is Ai. Please call me Ai. I am a 44-year-old woman. I do not live with my father.

dialogue.content: 愛さん、ありがとうございます。同居されてはいない、のですね。半年、お家で療養中、とのことですが、いろいろお困りごとがあって、こちらに相談にこられたと思います。よかったらお困りごと、お聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you, Ai. So you don't live together. You mentioned he's been recuperating at home for six months, and I imagine there are various concerns that brought you here to talk. If you'd like, could you share what's been troubling you?

dialogue.content: 全然リハビリしない、となると、社会復帰も心配ですね。お父さまのお世話をしている人のご負担、とか？話しやすいところからで。
dialogue.English: If he's not doing any rehabilitation, his return to society must be a concern. Perhaps the burden on his caregiver? Please start with whatever is easiest for you to talk about.

dialogue.content: 父は母と2人で暮らしております。母が、色々とやっておりまして、母が心配なのと
dialogue.English: My father lives with my mother, just the two of them. My mother is doing various things for him, and I'm worried about her, and...

dialogue.content: 父親は、このまま歩けなくなって良いのか
dialogue.English: And I wonder if my father is okay with becoming unable to walk like this.

dialogue.content: 回復するように、何故努力しないのか？
dialogue.English: Why won't he make an effort to recover?

dialogue.content: 父と母は、すごく困ってるようには私には見せません
dialogue.English: My father and mother don't show me that they're really struggling.

dialogue.content: 困ってないのかもしれません
dialogue.English: Maybe they aren't struggling.

dialogue.content: あら、お世話をしているお母さままで！愛さんは、ご両親にどうなってほしいと思っていますか？
dialogue.English: Oh, even your mother who is caring for him! Ai, what do you hope for your parents?

dialogue.content: 2人が良いのなら良いのですが。
dialogue.English: If they are both fine with it, then I suppose it's okay, but...

dialogue.content: 娘としては、父にまた歩いて欲しいです
dialogue.English: But as their daughter, I want my father to walk again.

dialogue.content: そうですね。なぜお父さまがリハビリをしないのか、お父様に聞いたことありますか？
dialogue.English: Yes, that's understandable. Have you ever asked your father why he won't do rehabilitation?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まだ先でも、間に合うと思っているようです
dialogue.English: He seems to think he can do it later and it will still be okay.

dialogue.content: リハビリは、しんどいから
dialogue.English: Because rehabilitation is tough...

dialogue.content: 最悪の事態になってから、やると
dialogue.English: He says he'll do it when things get really bad.

dialogue.content: 実際は？リハビリを先延ばしにすると、どうなるのでしょう？
dialogue.English: In reality? What do you think will happen if he keeps postponing rehabilitation?

dialogue.content: 私の考えですが
dialogue.English: This is just my opinion, but...

dialogue.content: まだ、軽いうちにリハビリしたほうが、負担なく早く回復するように思うのです。
dialogue.English: I think it would be less strenuous and he'd recover faster if he started rehab while it's still a minor issue.

dialogue.content: そのように聞きますよね。お父さまは、リハビリをされていた時期もありましたか？
dialogue.English: That is what we often hear. Was there a time when your father was doing rehabilitation?

dialogue.content: ほとんど、無いと思います
dialogue.English: I don't think he ever really has.

dialogue.content: では、リハビリをしっかりやると、どれだけ大変で、だけど、どれだけ効果ある、というのも、身をもってご存じない？
dialogue.English: So he doesn't have firsthand experience of how difficult proper rehabilitation is, but also how effective it can be?

dialogue.content: そうかもしれません
dialogue.English: That might be the case.

dialogue.content: 私の聞いた話ですと、リハビリのメニューや計画を、ご本人はもとより、ご家族、ご親族にも説明して、協力してもらう、というようですが、お母さまは、一番身近にいるご家族、リハビリについて、どう思っていらっしゃるのでしょうね？
dialogue.English: From what I've heard, the rehabilitation program and plan are usually explained not just to the patient, but also to their family and relatives to get their cooperation. I wonder what your mother, as his closest family member, thinks about the rehabilitation?

dialogue.content: 全然やろうとしない！って愚痴っては、いますが。具体的に考えてるのかは、わかりません
dialogue.English: She complains, "He won't even try!" but I don't know if she has any concrete thoughts about it.

dialogue.content: 長年のご夫婦の、力関係とか、言いたいことを言ってきた、とか、そういうもどかしさもあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Could there be some frustration related to their long-standing marital dynamic, like the balance of power or things left unsaid?

dialogue.content: どういうことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by that?

dialogue.content: 言葉足らずでごめんなさい。お父さまが亭主関白で、お母さまは長年、言いたいことを抑えてきていたり、お父さまは言うことを聞かなかったり、で、今もお母さまのリハビリしてほしい気持ちを伝えられていない、のかと思いまして。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I didn't explain that well. I was wondering if perhaps your father is a bit of a domineering husband, and your mother has held back from saying what she thinks for many years, or that your father doesn't listen, and so even now she can't convey her wish for him to do rehabilitation.

dialogue.content: 亭主関白気味ではあります。人の言うことは、聞き入れないところも。母は、言いたいことは抑えず言っていますが。。聞いてもらえることは、少ないかと
dialogue.English: He is a bit domineering. He also has a tendency not to listen to what others say. My mother says what she wants without holding back, but I think he rarely listens to her.

dialogue.content: 私も言いましたが
dialogue.English: I've told him too, but...

dialogue.content: あまり人から指図されたくない方で
dialogue.English: He's the type who doesn't like to be told what to do by others.

dialogue.content: 自分がやる！と決めないと難しいのかもしれません
dialogue.English: It might be difficult unless he decides for himself, "I'm going to do it!"

dialogue.content: 人から指図されたくない方、でしたら、リハビリはお父さまの性格に合わないのかも知れませんね。自分がやる！と決めたことなら、今までもやってこられたのですか？
dialogue.English: If he's someone who doesn't like being told what to do, then rehabilitation might not suit his personality. In the past, has he followed through on things he decided to do himself?

dialogue.content: そうですね。自分で決めたことは、やっているように思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I think he does follow through on things he decides himself.

dialogue.content: お父さまの性格の一端が見えてきた気がします。愛さんの記憶にある中で「お父さん、よく頑張ったな」とか「よく挑戦したな」とか、覚えていることってありますか？
dialogue.English: I feel like I'm starting to see a part of your father's personality. Is there anything you remember where you thought, "Dad really worked hard on that," or "He really took on that challenge"?

dialogue.content: 勤め先が倒産した時に、次の仕事に就くために、資格を取得して仕事を見つけたことを思いだしました。
dialogue.English: I remembered that when his company went bankrupt, he earned a certification to get his next job and found work.

dialogue.content: まぁ、逆境を励みにされたご経験が！「次の仕事に就くために」という目標があって「資格を取得して」という手段をやり遂げられた、のですね。
dialogue.English: Wow, so he has experience turning adversity into motivation! He had the goal of "getting his next job" and he achieved it by the means of "getting a certification."

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: リハビリも、似てませんか？
dialogue.English: Isn't rehabilitation similar?

dialogue.content: 似ていますか？
dialogue.English: Does it?

dialogue.content: 「もう一度歩く」という目標があって「歩くための機能回復＝リハビリ」という手段、かな、と思ったのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I thought perhaps there's the goal of "walking again," and the means to achieve it is "recovering function to walk = rehabilitation." What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: もう一度歩くと思ってないのかなぁ
dialogue.English: I wonder if he doesn't think about walking again.

dialogue.content: 歩くことは、まさに、いろいろな行動の「第一歩」ですね。歩かないとできないこと、で、お父さまが好きそうなこと、とか、目標があれば、どうでしょうかね？
dialogue.English: Walking is quite literally the "first step" to many activities. If there were a goal, like something your father might enjoy that he can't do without walking, how would that be?

dialogue.content: それがあれば良いのですが。いま、家にいて、テレビを見て、ゆっくりしているのは、幸せみたいなんです。外に出れないことは、全然嫌じゃないって。
dialogue.English: It would be great if there were something like that. Right now, he seems happy just being at home, watching TV, and relaxing. He says he doesn't mind not being able to go out at all.

dialogue.content: 外に出て欲しいと心配するのは、ありがた迷惑でしょうか
dialogue.English: Is my worrying and wanting him to go out just being a nuisance?

dialogue.content: 愛さんの思いがありがた迷惑なんて、娘としての純粋な願いですよね。ちっとも迷惑じゃないと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: Your feelings are far from being a nuisance; it's a sincere wish as a daughter. I don't think it's a nuisance at all.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 前向きな目標が思いつかなければ、「もし、このままの状態が続くと、どうなる？」を考えてみましょうか？
dialogue.English: If we can't think of a positive goal, shall we consider, "What will happen if this situation continues as is?"

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お父さまは、家にいられてお幸せですが、お母さまのことが心配、とおっしゃっていましたね。お母さま、どうなってしまうと思われますか？
dialogue.English: Your father is happy at home, but you mentioned you were worried about your mother. What do you think will happen to your mother?

dialogue.content: 心配な反面父の世話を出来て、嬉しい気持ちもあるんじゃないかと思うんです
dialogue.English: While I'm worried, I also think she might feel happy to be able to take care of my father.

dialogue.content: 色々と大変だとは思いますが
dialogue.English: Although I'm sure it's difficult in many ways.

dialogue.content: あー、妻としての、そういう気持ちもあるんじゃないか、と。お父さま、今まで働き者でいらして、家で一緒に過ごすことも少なかった、とか？
dialogue.English: Ah, so you think she might have those feelings as a wife. Was your father a hard worker before and didn't spend much time at home with her?

dialogue.content: そうですね。2人とも働き詰めで
dialogue.English: That's right. They both worked constantly.

dialogue.content: お父さまの足の調子が悪いのをきっかけに、今は、夫婦蜜月が、やっと来た、という感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, with your father's leg trouble as a trigger, is it like they're finally having their honeymoon period now?

dialogue.content: そういう部分もあると思います
dialogue.English: I think there's a part of that, yes.

dialogue.content: この先も蜜月でいられそうでしょうか？愛さん、ご懸念は？
dialogue.English: Do you think this honeymoon period will continue? Ai, what are your concerns?

dialogue.content: どうでしょうか
dialogue.English: I wonder.

dialogue.content: この先も変わらずやっていきそうですが
dialogue.English: It seems like they'll continue on like this without change, but...

dialogue.content: 歩けなくなってもいいのかなぁ
dialogue.English: I still wonder if it's okay for him to become unable to walk.

dialogue.content: 愛さんの、そういう心配な気持ち、最近、お父さんに伝えられたこと、ありますか？
dialogue.English: Ai, have you shared those worries with your father recently?

dialogue.content: 最近は、伝えてないです
dialogue.English: I haven't told him recently.

dialogue.content: 気持ちもさることながら、リハビリを先延ばしにすると、どうなってしまうか？お父さまもお母さまも、現実をどのくらいわかってらっしゃるのでしょうか、気になりました。
dialogue.English: Aside from the emotional aspect, I wonder how well your father and mother understand the reality of what will happen if rehabilitation is postponed.

dialogue.content: 私もです
dialogue.English: I wonder that too.

dialogue.content: 今、夫婦で、かりそめの蜜月の中にいて、この先の、残酷かもしれない現実（医療的なこと、とか）に向き合っていないとしたら。。。
dialogue.English: If they are in a temporary honeymoon period right now and not facing the potentially harsh reality ahead (like medical issues)...

dialogue.content: 愛さん、なにか、できること、思いつきますか？
dialogue.English: Ai, does anything come to mind that you could do?

dialogue.content: お医者さんから、どのように言われているか、聞いてみようかと
dialogue.English: I'm thinking of asking what the doctor has been telling them.

dialogue.content: 人に話すことで、気付くかもしれません
dialogue.English: By talking about it, they might realize something.

dialogue.content: そうですね。自分の口からでた言葉を耳にすることで、ハッとすることってありますね。良いと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: That's right. Sometimes hearing the words come out of your own mouth can make you realize something. I think that's a good idea.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 愛さん、おひとりで、ご両親のところに行かれますか？どなたか、一緒に支えてくれる方、いませんか？
dialogue.English: Ai, will you go to your parents' place by yourself? Is there anyone who can support you?

dialogue.content: ご兄弟とか？
dialogue.English: Siblings, perhaps?

dialogue.content: 弟がいます
dialogue.English: I have a younger brother.

dialogue.content: 味方は多い方が心強いものですが、弟さんと協同した方が愛さんには心地よいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's always more reassuring to have more allies. Would it be more comfortable for you to work together with your brother?

dialogue.content: もしくは、お父さまに効果的か？とか？
dialogue.English: Or perhaps more effective for your father?

dialogue.content: 心地よいというか弟の方が両親の面倒をみてくれています。
dialogue.English: It's not so much about comfort, but my brother is the one who mainly looks after our parents.

dialogue.content: ひとりに言われるより、ふたりから言われる方が、お父さまに響くのであれば、弟さんともお話しされてみるのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If hearing it from two people would resonate more with your father than from just one, how about talking with your brother about it?

dialogue.content: 愛さんおひとりが抱え込まれるのが心配になりましたので。
dialogue.English: I was just worried about you shouldering this all by yourself.

dialogue.content: 弟からも、言ってるんです。。
dialogue.English: My brother has been telling him too...

dialogue.content: ひとりで、抱え込んではいないのですが
dialogue.English: So I'm not shouldering it alone, but...

dialogue.content: と、いうことは、弟さんの援護射撃を愛さんが今回する、ということになりますかね？
dialogue.English: So, does that mean you would be providing some backup for your brother this time?

dialogue.content: するべきなのか
dialogue.English: I'm not sure if I should.

dialogue.content: そもそもです
dialogue.English: That's the fundamental question.

dialogue.content: そもそも？
dialogue.English: The fundamental question?

dialogue.content: 歩くように何か働きかけるのが、そもそも良いのか
dialogue.English: Whether it's right in the first place to try and get him to walk,

dialogue.content: 父親の自発的な行動を待つ方がよいのか
dialogue.English: or if it's better to wait for my father to act on his own.

dialogue.content: 親を変えたい訳ではないので
dialogue.English: It's not that I want to change my parent.

dialogue.content: 半年間、お父さまを待っていたのでしたね？リハビリは早い方が良い、と？
dialogue.English: You have been waiting for your father for half a year, haven't you? And you believe that starting rehab earlier is better?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お父さま、人から指図されて変わることはないかも知れませんが、愛さんと会話することで、気づきがあるかも知れませんね。
dialogue.English: Your father may not change just because someone tells him to, but through conversation with you, he might come to a realization.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: 話してみます
dialogue.English: I'll try talking to him.

dialogue.content: ご自身で、気づいて、決意すれば、行動に移される方、と。
dialogue.English: He's the type of person who takes action once he realizes something and makes up his own mind.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 愛さんが後悔しないよう、お話しできることを応援しています！
dialogue.English: I'm rooting for you to be able to have a conversation so that you don't have any regrets, Ai!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Thank you!

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間なのですが、他に気になっていることとか、ありますか？
dialogue.English: Our time is almost up, but is there anything else on your mind?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です。今日は、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: I'm fine, thank you. Thank you so much for today.

dialogue.content: （すみません、時間オーバーしていますが、クロージングに入ります）そうですか。お役に立てたなら、なによりです。それでは、終了させていただきますね。ありがとうございました。（ありがとうございます！）
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry, we've gone over time, but I'll begin closing now.) I see. I'm very glad if I was able to help. Well then, I will conclude our session now. Thank you very much. (Thank you!)

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました（時間大丈夫です！ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. (It's okay about the time! Thank you!)

dialogue.content: （タイムマネジメント、難しいですね、勉強します！では、終了メッセージをお送りしますね。愛情あふれるクライアント役さんで、助けていただく場面もありました、御礼申し上げます。また、マッチングした際は、どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。ありがとうございました！）
dialogue.English: (Time management is difficult, I'll work on it! I will send the closing message now. Your portrayal as a client was full of warmth and care, and there were times you helped me out, so thank you very much. If we are matched again, I look forward to working with you. Thank you!)
